parameters.name: BindMiniProgram
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to bind a mini program. Valid values:

- **Y**: enabled.
- **N** (default): disabled.
><notice>If you enable mini program binding, make sure that you specify all parameters related to the mini program binding.></notice>

parameters.name: CheckFileBody
parameters.description: The content of the uploaded verification file.

parameters.name: CheckFileName
parameters.description: The name of the uploaded verification file.

parameters.name: DeviceRiskPlus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable enhanced device risk detection. Valid values:

- **Y**: enabled.
- **N**: disabled.

parameters.name: MiniProgramName
parameters.description: The name of the mini program.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The mini program platform. Valid values:

- **WECHAT**: WeChat.
- **ALIPAY**: Alipay.
- **TIKTOK**: TikTok.

parameters.name: ReturnPicCount
parameters.description: The number of returned photos (1 to 5). This parameter takes effect after storeImage is enabled for authentication file retention.

parameters.name: ReturnVideoLength
parameters.description: The duration of the returned video (1 to 2 seconds). This parameter takes effect after storeImage is enabled.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: This parameter has no effect. You do not need to specify this parameter.

parameters.name: StoreImage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to deliver authentication files generated during the authentication process to your OSS bucket. Valid values:

- **Y**: enabled.
- **N** (default): disabled.
